label: Rent agreement (residential or commercial tenancy)

review.note: Fixed clauses are a plain tenancy agreement. They have not yet been reviewed by a practising advocate, and state rent-control laws may add requirements.

notes: A lease for more than one year must be registered (Section 17, Registration Act, 1908). Many landlords use an 11-month agreement for this reason.
Stamp duty and any state rent-control rules vary by state. Check them before signing.

blocks.text: This Agreement is made at {{place}} on {{agreement_date|date}} between {{landlord_name}}, residing at {{landlord_address}} (the "Landlord"), and {{tenant_name}}, whose permanent address is {{tenant_address}} (the "Tenant").
The Landlord is the owner of the property at {{property_address}} (the "Property") and the Tenant wishes to take it on rent. The Parties agree as follows:
Tenancy and term. The Landlord lets the Property to the Tenant for {{term_months}} months from {{start_date|date}} for {{use}} use only.
Rent. The Tenant shall pay rent of {{rent_amount|inr}} ({{rent_amount|words}}) per month, on or before day {{rent_due_day}} of each month.

Security deposit. The Tenant has paid or shall pay a security deposit of {{deposit_amount|inr}} ({{deposit_amount|words}}), which carries no interest. The Landlord shall return it when the Tenant vacates and hands over the Property, after deducting only dues that are unpaid at that time.
Use. The Tenant shall use the Property only for the use stated above, keep it in good condition, and shall not sub-let it or part with possession of it without the Landlord's written consent.
Inspection and repairs. The Landlord may inspect the Property at reasonable times after giving notice. The Tenant shall bear the cost of repairs for damage caused by the Tenant.

Ending the tenancy. Either Party may end this tenancy by giving {{notice_months}} month(s) written notice to the other. On ending, the Tenant shall vacate and hand over peaceful possession of the Property.
Governing law and jurisdiction. This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. The courts at {{jurisdiction_city}} have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from it.
The Parties have signed this Agreement on the date first written above, in the presence of the witnesses named below.
